title: A member who buys MettleUp Plus during a workout still gets no suggested weights in that workout
what: Once the paid plan lock is switched on, a free member sees a 'suggestions are part of Plus' line on each exercise and can tap it to buy. The workout remembers its suggestions by the exercises and settings only, not by whether the member may use them. After buying and coming back, the workout thinks it already has its answer (none), so no suggested weight appears, and the locked line also goes away. Suggestions only show once an exercise is added, swapped or a setting changes, or in the next workout. Not live today: the lock is off for everyone.
expected: Right after paying, the open workout shows suggested weights on every exercise.
who: members who buy Plus from inside a workout
how_often: every purchase made during a workout, once the lock is on
fix_line: Make the workout recheck its suggestions when the member's plan changes.

items.reason: No test or live payment switch in this area; it only asks the shared plan check, whose QA stand-in lives in the plan folder.
No amount, price or receipt is stored or shown by the workout data and stores; the two listed features are workout plans, not paid plans.
